name: pickup_type_meta_find_by_name
description: PickupTypeMeta::FindByName maps a pickup logical name to its PickupType entry through PickupTypeKeyTable::FindIndex and returns null for missing names.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Pickup type-table/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e1a0 validates fastcall ECX=typeName, a call to PickupTypeKeyTable::FindIndex, null return for negative index, and &g_PickupTypes[index] for nonnegative index.
The native smoke verifies first, middle, and last logical-name matches return the corresponding g_PickupTypes entry and a missing name returns null.
